title: Automated Low-Input Plant Organic HMW DNA Extraction of Bryophyta
author: Benjamin Jackson
materials: Preheat the lysis buffer for 15 minutes, 65 °C at 400 rpm on a ThermoMixer prior to use, ensuring the total dissolution of reagents.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the Plant Direct Lysis Buffer and add DTT and Proteinase K immediately prior to use, ensuring reagents are thoroughly mixed.

steps.title: Pre-incubate Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer 1.0 mL FluidX tubes (with 2.0 mL adaptor sleeves) containing 1 to 30 mg of cryogenically disrupted frozen tissue to a cold block on wet ice and incubate for approximately 10 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Sample Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse the samples using preheated buffer and RNase A.

substeps.instruction: Add 550 μL preheated lysis buffer (65 °C) to the first sample, gently invert without rattling the zirconia bead, and place on a ThermoMixer at 55 °C and 900 rpm. Repeat for all samples.
After 15 minutes, add 4 µL RNase A to each sample.
Incubate for another 30 minutes at 55 °C and 900 rpm.
Do not agitate for the final 15 minutes of lysis to allow unlysed sediment to settle.

steps.title: Prepare Precipitation Tubes
steps.instruction: While samples are incubating, prepare fresh 2 mL LoBind microcentrifuge tubes containing 100 μL potassium acetate (5 M; pH 7.4; 4 °C) for each sample and place on wet ice.

steps.title: Clarify Lysate
steps.instruction: Process the lysate based on the initial tissue mass.

substeps.instruction: If mass was >10 mg: Remove samples from heat block, allow lysate to settle for 5 minutes at RT, then centrifuge with 2.0 mL adaptor sleeve for 10 minutes at 8,000 rpm at room temperature. Avoid pellet debris when aspirating.
If mass was <10 mg: Do not centrifuge; remove samples from heat block and proceed to transfer step, including all lysate and debris.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysate to the potassium acetate solution and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Double check sample order after centrifugation.
Incubate samples on wet ice for 5–10 minutes (up to 60 minutes).
Remove 500 μL of Speedbead solution per sample from the fridge to equilibrate to room temperature.
Pre-chill a 2 mL centrifuge to 4 °C.

Use a wide-bore P1000 pipette tip, then a normal-bore P200 pipette tip at slow speed, to transfer the supernatant (or full lysate) to the 2 mL LoBind tubes containing 100 μL cold 5 M potassium acetate.
Gently mix by inversion until homogenous (supernatant should become whitish, opaque, and slightly viscous).

steps.title: Perform Chloroform Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the aqueous phase in a fume hood.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μL cold chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1, v/v; -20 °C) to the samples.
Mix on a Hulamixer at 25 rpm for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 21,000 g at 4 °C, ensuring tube hinges face outwards.
Transfer up to 700 μL of the aqueous phase (top layer) to a fresh 2 mL LoBind microcentrifuge tube using a wide-bore P1000 pipette tip, aspirating carefully from the top to avoid the interphase.

steps.title: Prepare KingFisher Plates
steps.instruction: Label and fill six 96-well deep-well KingFisher™ Apex plates as follows:

substeps.instruction: Plate 1 (LoPOE Tip plate): 96-well tip comb (no reagent).
Plate 2 (LoPOE Sample plate): Up to 700 µL aqueous phase + 500 μL SpeedBead solution (ensure SpeedBead solution is vortexed/mixed before use).
Plate 3 (LoPOE Ethanol wash 1.1): 1 mL 80% EtOH.
Plate 4 (LoPOE Ethanol wash 1.2): 1 mL 80% EtOH.
Plate 5 (LoPOE Elution plate 1): 150 µL Buffer EB.
Plate 6 (LoPOE Elution plate 2): 150 µL Buffer EB.

steps.title: Run Automated DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Execute the SPRI extraction on the KingFisher Apex instrument.

substeps.instruction: Switch on the KingFisher Apex and select 'Run protocol'.
Select the 'LoPOE single SPRI' protocol and press play.
Load the filled plates according to on-screen instructions and click play.
Wait approximately 90 minutes for the 1X SpeedBead SPRI to finish.

steps.title: Collect and Concentrate DNA
steps.instruction: Combine elutions and concentrate the sample.

substeps.instruction: Remove LoPOE elution plates 1 and 2.
Use an 8-channel wide-bore P200 pipette to transfer both elutions per sample into single 0.7 mL FluidX tubes (keep lids off until after concentration).
Transfer 0.7 mL FluidX tubes (~400 µL elution) with 2.0 mL adaptor sleeves (lids removed) to the Eppendorf Concentrator Plus.
Run for 60 minutes at 60 °C using setting 'V-AQ'.

steps.title: Final Storage
steps.instruction: Seal and store the extracted DNA.

substeps.instruction: Remove samples from the concentrator and screw lids onto the tubes.
Incubate samples overnight at room temperature.
Perform QC checks; store DNA long-term at 4 °C.
